rules.name: Electives not cross-listed with your primary department, and no courses shared with a concurrent master's
rules.desc:
For a PhD minor in Computational and Mathematical Engineering (CME), a doctoral candidate must complete 21 units of approved graduate-level courses.

All courses must be taken for a letter grade and passed with a grade of B or better. Elective courses cannot be cross-listed with the student’s primary department. If a student is concurrently enrolled in a Master's program, there can be no overlap between the MA/MS courses and the PhD minor courses. Minor programs should be developed in close discussion between the student and the student’s primary PhD advisor.

rules.name: Electives
rules.desc: Complete at least 3 courses and 9 units from the specialized depth electives list in the Computational and Mathematical Engineering PhD. To petition for a course that is not on this list to count toward the minor, please contact ICME student services.

grading: All courses must be taken for a letter grade and passed with a grade of B or better.
transferPolicy: Per policy (GAP 4.5.1 Doctoral Degrees, Requirements), all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks CME 302, 306 and 307, one programming course, and at least 3 courses and 9 units from the CME PhD's specialized depth electives, 21 units in all. Every course must be letter graded with a B or better. You check by hand that no elective is cross-listed with your own PhD department and that no course also counts toward a master's you are doing at the same time. A petitioned elective that is not on the list is moved in by hand once ICME student services approves it.
